dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Autoimmune (inflammatory) cerebellar ataxia — cause likely paraneoplastic, anti-GAD, or other antibody-mediated (specific antibody pending); CSF inflammatory changes with normal OCBs and normal MRI support an immune-mediated process rather than a structural lesion.

1. Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration (screen for underlying malignancy and onconeural antibodies such as anti-Yo, anti-Hu, anti-Ri, anti-CV2, anti-mGluR1, anti-VGCC, anti-Ma2)
2. Multiple system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C) — would expect pontocerebellar atrophy, "hot cross bun" sign, and autonomic dysfunction on follow-up
3. Post-infectious / acute cerebellitis of autoimmune type, or less likely an inherited spinocerebellar ataxia with late or atypical presentation
